data.name: Improved Drag (Mythic)
data.description: You pull your enemies around the battlefield with great ease.

raw_tokens.value: You pull your enemies around the battlefield with great ease.

You gain a bonus equal to half your tier on checks to attempt a drag combat maneuver, and to your CMD when an opponent attempts a drag combat maneuver against you. These bonuses stack with those granted by Improved Drag.&nl;Furthermore, you can make an attack of opportunity against any creature that attempts a drag maneuver against you, unless it also has this feat.
